description: Dodge Roll becomes Shoulder Through: a shorter charge, and where you stop the ground flares, throwing enemies back and setting them alight. +6% Movement Speed.

name: Banked Fire
description: Unlocks Banked Fire: a fire banked around you that strikes everything close every second, hotter with every strike, up to twice as hot.

name: Fire Burst
description: Unlocks Fire Burst: flame bursts on the ground a few steps ahead, and whatever it catches keeps burning.
